creative_direction.name: Viridian Ribbon Orbit
creative_direction.brief: An experimental graphic orbit: on a deep viridian matte field, one continuous pale-mint ribbon band sweeps in a flat printed loop, diving behind the flacon's waist and re-emerging at the opposite shoulder so the silhouette itself completes the circuit. No floor, no horizon - the ribbon is the only architecture, echoing the ribbed gold cap as a drawn line against lacquer volume. The product sits low and left-weighted while a right-hand stacked column carries the monument: tracked narrow-sans brand line at column head, the name across three tall wrapped lines, a short horizontal rule closing the column; vertical overlap with the cap zone but wide horizontal clearance keeps the asymmetric grid deliberate.
creative_direction.material: flat matte gouache-painted card with one continuous hard-edge printed ribbon loop
creative_direction.lighting: perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, flat graphic light with no falloff

background.prompt: Seamless flat matte gouache-painted card in deep viridian green, one continuous hard-edge flat ribbon loop in pale mint sweeping from lower left behind centre and re-emerging upper right, perfectly even shadowless illumination, no texture gradients, no objects
